_rationale: INC-4: every search row used to carry block_type="lines", so --context-filter function|class kept nothing and returned count=0. This golden pins the CLI end-to-end path (built binary -> server /search -> SearchEngine rows -> CLI post-filter) resolving each hit to its enclosing symbol kind. All three multi-lang `add` hits are functions, so context.block_type must read "function" and block_name "add"; a regression to the "lines" sentinel fails here.
